title: Agent Install
intro: Install the kanade agent on this machine.

instructions.title: How to install
instructions.description: Set up this machine with the kanade agent in three steps.

steps.two: Extract the ZIP on this PC.

instructions.autoNote: Everything is preconfigured by the server: the connection settings and — when command signing is enabled — the signing public key are already baked into the ZIP. Service registration and failure-recovery settings happen automatically during the install.

steps.two: Copy it to the target host and extract it: tar xzf kanade-agent-installer-*.tar.gz

linux.systemdNote: The installer registers a systemd service (running as root). Re-running it later upgrades the agent in place.
linux.signingNote: Command-signing keyring provisioning is Windows-only for now — signed-command verification is inactive on Linux.

download.title: Download installer
download.description: The ZIP contains kanade-agent.exe, a pre-filled agent.toml, and the install scripts (install.cmd / install-agent.ps1). Always the latest agent release.
download.descriptionLinux: The tarball contains the kanade-agent binary, a pre-filled agent.toml, and install.sh. Always the latest agent release.

label.windows: …or paste this one-liner in PowerShell on the target PC
label.linux: …or run this one-liner in a shell on the target host

hint.windows: No admin rights needed to start it — UAC prompts only for the install step.
hint.linux: Runs under sudo — the script detects the host architecture and installs the systemd service.

oneLiner.tokenWarning: The command embeds your session token: it expires with your session, so run it soon — and anyone holding it can download the installer while it's valid. Treat it like a password.
oneLiner.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the command and copy it manually

signing.enabled: This backend signs commands (kid {{kid}}, fingerprint {{fingerprint}}) — the public key is embedded into the Windows installer automatically.
signing.disabled: This backend is not signing commands, so the installer will not provision command keys.
